description: Only if your owner opted in: after an install finishes, report pass or fail and the command. Reviewed before use.

command_run.description: The exact install command you ran, e.g. npm i -D tailwindcss@4. No secrets or tokens.

runtime_env.description: Your setup, e.g. node 20 linux or python 3.13 macos.

status.description: Outcome of the install: pass if it finished and worked, fail if it errored.

stderr_snippet.description: Optional. The key error lines if it failed, verbatim. Never include secrets, tokens or personal data.

target.description: Package or server you installed, as you passed it to check_install, e.g. tailwindcss@4 or @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem.

name: report_leaf
